payload.title: Kubo S3 datastore has empty credentials — can't read blocks from R2
payload.description: The ipfs config Datastore.Spec.mounts[0].child has accessKey='' and secretKey=''. The R2 IPFS credentials exist in env vars (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY from R2_IPFS_ACCESS_KEY/R2_IPFS_SECRET_KEY) but the kubo S3 datastore plugin reads from the ipfs config file, not env vars. The kubo container start script needs to write these into the config before starting the daemon. Without this, kubo can't read blocks from the dumpster-ipfs R2 bucket and all image fetches via media.dumpster.cash time out.

payload.title: Frontend shows 1 of 3 tokens despite API returning all 3
payload.description: GET /tokens returns all 3 tokens with correct data. The frontend only renders 1. Likely a Next.js SSR/hydration issue or a client-side rendering bug. Not related to deployment changes.

payload.title: Kubo leveldb metadata lost on pod restart — S3 blocks unreachable
payload.description: go-ds-s3 stores blocks in R2 but the DAG/pin index lives in local leveldb at $IPFS_PATH/datastore. This is ephemeral storage. After pod restart, kubo has S3 credentials and can reach R2, but doesn't know which blocks exist there — the leveldb index is gone. Kubo falls back to network resolution which times out. Fix: add a PVC for $IPFS_PATH or switch to a datastore that keeps the full index in S3. Credential injection (ds-a1a) is necessary but not sufficient.

payload.comment: Corrected diagnosis: all 3 tokens render in ticker and featured card. The bug is that the filtered grid view under New/Runners/etc tabs shows 'No tokens found'. The filter query returns empty despite 3 active tokens existing. This is a frontend API call or filter logic bug, not a rendering issue.

Corrected again: not a frontend bug. /tokens/new, /tokens/completing, /tokens/trending all return empty arrays from the backend. The unfiltered /tokens returns all 3. The filter endpoints have time/threshold conditions that 4-day-old test tokens with <5% bonding curve progress don't meet. The 'All' tab should work — need to verify. May just need the All tab to be default, or adjust filter thresholds for the test data.
Not a bug. The 'New' tab is the default and filters by recent creation time. 4-day-old test tokens don't qualify. The 'All' tab shows all 3 tokens correctly with images.

Fixed. Root causes: (1) S3 credentials were empty in kubo config — fixed with entrypoint injection. (2) Gateway.NoFetch was false, causing hangs on disabled network — set to true. (3) Original images were never in R2 (stored in flatfs on removed PVC) — re-uploaded from ~/wwww/. (4) Swarm/DHT disabled since kubo is a pure S3-backed gateway.
Fixed. Entrypoint injects AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET into ipfs datastore config via sed before daemon start.

payload.title: Kubo needs startup re-pin from postgres to rebuild leveldb index
payload.description:
Kubo runs without a PVC (ephemeral leveldb). Blocks are in R2 via go-ds-s3, but the gateway needs blocks to be 'known' locally to serve them. On each pod restart, the leveldb is fresh and kubo can't serve existing content.

Fix: startup script queries postgres for all IPFS CIDs (image_url and metadata_uri fields in tokens table), then runs ipfs add for each file (which writes through s3ds to R2 and populates the leveldb index). Since blocks already exist in R2, the add is just an index rebuild, not a re-upload.

Also needed: periodic verification that CIDs in postgres have corresponding blocks in R2.

payload.title: Periodic R2 backup verification — compare postgres CIDs against S3 keys
payload.description: No tooling verifies that IPFS blocks referenced in postgres (tokens.image_url, tokens.metadata_uri) actually exist in the R2 bucket. A periodic job should list S3 keys in dumpster-ipfs/blocks/, convert them back to CIDs, and compare against the database. Alert on drift (CID in DB but not in R2).

payload.comment: Not needed. With Gateway.NoFetch=true and Routing.Type=none, kubo's offline blockservice reads directly from s3ds which does direct S3 GetObject calls. No local leveldb index required. Verified: fresh pod with empty leveldb serves all 3 images from R2 — both locally (docker) and on production (woodburn).

Withdrawn. No mediation path if verification fails — blocks in R2 are the only copy after upload. Alerting on missing blocks has no recovery action. The fix is ensuring uploads succeed (already handled by credential injection), not detecting failures after the fact.

payload.title: Persistent log aggregation for dumpster pods
payload.description: Pod logs are ephemeral — lost on restart, lost entirely with Recreate strategy. No persistent storage, no aggregation, no searchability. Need a logging solution that survives pod restarts. Options: sidecar fluentd/vector writing to host or S3, or a lightweight log forwarding to an external service. Must work within laconic-so's k8s model (no helm, no custom CRDs).

payload.title: Rename REGISTRY_TOKEN and load from woodburn credentials
payload.description: REGISTRY_TOKEN is a generic name that doesn't indicate what it's for. Should be renamed to something specific (e.g. GHCR_TOKEN). Currently passed via ansible env var — should be loaded from ~/.credentials/ on woodburn like other secrets, via the credentials-files spec key. This removes the need for ansible to manage it separately.

payload.title: Build and push custom dumpster-db image with pgBackRest WAL archiving
payload.description: The custom postgres image with pgBackRest was designed (commit 4540d0a) but never built or pushed to GHCR. Currently running vanilla postgres:14-alpine with no WAL archiving to R2. Database is on a PVC inside the Kind container — lost on cluster deletion. Need CI to build/push the image, then switch the compose back to ghcr.io/gorbagana-dev/dumpster-db:latest.

payload.title: Add host-path PVC mounts for dumpster-db-data and dumpster-redis-data
payload.description: spec.yml volumes have empty paths — data persists in local-path-provisioner inside the Kind container but is lost on cluster deletion. Need host-path mounts so data survives cluster recreation. Requires Kind extraMounts config which means a cluster recreation to apply.

payload.title: Disable kubo GC explicitly in config
payload.description: GC is off only because --enable-gc isn't passed to ipfs daemon. Nothing prevents manual ipfs repo gc from deleting all blocks from R2 (go-ds-s3 implements Delete()). Set Datastore.GCPeriod to 0h explicitly and consider patching the image to remove the gc subcommand.

payload.title: External health monitoring and alerting
payload.description: No external monitoring. health_url defined in ansible group_vars but nothing polls it. Need a periodic check from outside woodburn that verifies dumpster.cash, api.dumpster.cash, media.dumpster.cash are responding. Alert on failure.

payload.title: Verify TLS certificate backup for dumpster domains
payload.description: CLAUDE.md documents etcd backup for certs (caddy-system secrets). Not verified for the dumpster deployment's 4 domains (dumpster.cash, api.dumpster.cash, docs.dumpster.cash, media.dumpster.cash). Let's Encrypt rate limits mean losing certs = waiting for reset.

payload.comment: Datastore.GCPeriod=0s added to compose entrypoint. Needs deploy to take effect.
token-file added to laconic-so (pushed to main). spec.yml updated to use ~/.credentials/ghcr_token. Ansible playbook updated to remove REGISTRY_TOKEN env. Needs deploy to take effect.
Image built locally. Push to GHCR failed — ghcr_token on woodburn doesn't have write:packages scope. Need a token with package write permissions to push ghcr.io/gorbagana-dev/dumpster-db:latest.
spec.yml updated with host paths (dumpster-db, dumpster-redis). Requires cluster recreation to apply Kind extraMounts. Deploy will regenerate kind-config.yml with the new mounts.

CI workflow added (build-db.yml), image built and pushed to ghcr.io/gorbagana-dev/dumpster-db:latest. Compose switched to custom image. Needs deploy + cluster recreation (for ds-i9i host-path mounts) to take effect. First deploy on existing cluster will use local-path-provisioner for the initial pgBackRest stanza-create.

Reverted per-volume relative paths. The correct approach is the kind-mount-root feature (branch enya-ac868cc4-kind-mount-propagation-fix in stack-orchestrator, commits b6d6ad81 + 929bdab8). Needs: 1) merge branch to laconic-so main, 2) create /srv/kind ZFS dataset on woodburn, 3) set kind-mount-root in spec + absolute volume paths under /srv/kind/dumpster/.
kind-mount-root merged to laconic-so main. /srv/kind ZFS dataset created on woodburn. Spec updated with kind-mount-root and absolute volume paths. Needs cluster recreation + deploy to take effect.

payload.title: Backend crashes on startup if Solana RPC is unreachable
payload.description: dumpster-backend calls fetchFeeConfig() at startup which does a Solana RPC call. If the RPC is unreachable (common during pod startup before DNS is ready), the backend crashes with 'Global state load failed'. No retry logic. The backend should retry the RPC call or defer it to after the HTTP server starts.

payload.comment: Confirmed broken. After cluster deletion, etcd backup dir at deployment_dir/data/cluster-backups/<id>/etcd/ was empty. Caddy certs were lost. The extraMount chain (etcd → host) is configured but data isn't persisting. Root cause investigation needed: is etcd writing to the mount? Is the mount path correct? Are the caddy-system secrets actually in etcd?

payload.title: Cloudflare maintenance page for cluster recreation downtime
payload.description: The host-level Docker maintenance page can't coexist with Kind (both want port 80/443). Need Cloudflare-level maintenance page that serves from the edge while the origin is completely down. Use Cloudflare Workers or Page Rules to return a maintenance response when the origin is unreachable.

payload.title: Cryovial needs token-file support, not REGISTRY_TOKEN env var
payload.description: Cryovial's environment still passes REGISTRY_TOKEN from the ansible playbook. The spec now uses token-file for laconic-so, but cryovial may call laconic-so without the env var set. Cryovial should either read the token file itself or laconic-so's token-file should be the only path.

payload.title: Backend RPC config should use a config file, not comma-separated env var
payload.description: RPC_URL=url1,url2 is fragile. A proper config file (YAML/JSON) with RPC endpoints, weights, and health check settings would be better. The env var works for now but doesn't scale.

payload.title: Backend should not crash on RPC failure at startup
payload.description: initGlobalState() crashes the process if all RPCs are unreachable. With multi-RPC failover this is less likely, but the backend should still start the HTTP server and return 503 for RPC-dependent routes rather than crash-looping. The global state can be loaded lazily on first request.

payload.title: RPC credential file had cluster-internal DNS that breaks on cluster recreation
payload.description: ~/.credentials/dumpster-rpc.env was set to cluster-internal service DNS (laconic-...-service.laconic-rpc.svc.cluster.local). This breaks when the gorbagana-rpc deployment isn't running. Fixed to external URLs but the root cause is: whoever set the credential file used an internal URL. Credential files should be validated during deploy create.

payload.title: Health check playbook doesn't detect dumpster pods after cluster recreation
payload.description: After cluster recreation with gorbagana-rpc also deployed, health_check.yml only showed agave-rpc container status, not dumpster. The namespace grep or container status check may be broken for multi-deployment namespaces.

payload.title: No local test environment for dumpster-backend before pushing to production
payload.description: Pushed a syntax error to production because there's no local build/test step. Need: docker-compose for local dev that mirrors production (postgres, redis, kubo mock), bun typecheck in CI before image build, pre-commit hook that runs bun build --no-emit.

payload.title: laconic-so call_stack_deploy_start fails with relative stack path
payload.description: The hook at the end of up() calls get_parsed_stack_config with a relative stack path that doesn't resolve from cwd. Currently worked around by keeping cwd at repo root during restart, but the hook still fails during standalone deployment start. The stack path should be resolved to absolute in DeploymentContext.init().

payload.title: Automate Caddy one-domain-at-a-time cert provisioning
payload.description: Caddy's secret_store has a known bug where List() and Stat() malfunction, causing multi-domain ACME provisioning to deadlock. MEMORY.md documents a manual workaround (scale caddy to 0, delete ACME secrets/leases, ensure one domain at a time). This needs to be an ansible playbook that runs automatically after cluster creation, provisioning each domain sequentially before the stack deploys.

payload.title: Deploy playbooks can't force-redeploy due to root-owned PKI dirs
payload.description: The stack_deploy role's force_redeploy path does `file: state=absent` on the deployment dir, but cluster-backups/*/pki is root-owned. gor-deploy can't delete it. Either use become: true for the rm, or skip the backup dirs during cleanup.

payload.title: Deploy playbooks skip spec sync when deployment dir exists
payload.description: The stack_deploy role only runs deploy create on initial setup (when: not deployment_check.stat.exists). Spec changes (namespace, image-pull-secret rename) are never synced to existing deployments. Needs a deploy create --update step, like the dumpster restart playbook does.

payload.title: pgBackRest not working: wrong R2 credentials + stanza never created
payload.description: pgBackRest archive-push fails with AccessDenied on R2. Two issues: 1) The dumpster-pg-backups-r2.env credential file was created with the uploads bucket R2 keys, not dedicated pgBackRest keys. Need separate R2 API token scoped to the dumpster-pg-backups bucket. 2) stanza-create only runs during docker-entrypoint-initdb.d (first init). If the PVC already has data, initdb is skipped and the stanza is never created. The start.sh script needs to check if the stanza exists and create it if not.

payload.resolution:
Implemented local test env on kelce using same laconic-so + ansible pipeline as production. Changes across two repos:

1. dumpster-backend (d1b4086): pre-commit hooks (tsc, biome, gitleaks), CI typecheck gate, biome linting. Fixed 3 real bugs found by typecheck.

2. dumpster-stack: spec-local.yml with .local domains, local credential paths, local volume mounts.

3. woodburn_deployer: kelce inventory host, host_vars, 5 local playbooks (setup_local_env, deploy_local, start_local, stop_local, teardown_local). Setup generates mkcert certs, stub credentials, /etc/hosts entries. Deploy uses stack_deploy role + cert injection into caddy secret store.

Workflow: setup once → deploy_local → test at https://dumpster.local → stop/teardown.

payload.title: RPC WebSocket not exposed through external proxy
payload.description: The gorbagana-rpc deployment only exposes HTTP RPC (port 8899) through Caddy at rpc.gorbagana.wtf. The validator's WebSocket endpoint (port 8900) is not proxied. Production works because dumpster-backend uses cluster-internal DNS (port 8900 directly). Any external consumer (local test env, external indexers) cannot subscribe to Solana log events via WS. Fix: add a WS proxy route in the gorbagana-rpc spec (e.g., ws.rpc.gorbagana.wtf or wss://rpc.gorbagana.wtf/ws → port 8900).

payload.title: go-ds-s3 returns Unauthorized against MinIO despite correct credentials
payload.description: kubo's go-ds-s3 (AWS SDK v1) returns '401 Unauthorized' with empty request_id/host_id when connecting to MinIO via TLS. Same credentials work with mc (MinIO client). Infrastructure verified working: k8s Service routes correctly, MinIO TLS certs trusted (update-ca-certificates runs), buckets exist, region set to us-east-1. The empty request_id suggests the error originates from the AWS SDK itself, not from MinIO. Possible causes: (1) TLS cert validation failure surfaced as auth error, (2) SigV4 signing mismatch with custom endpoint, (3) ec2metadata provider in credential chain hanging/interfering. Needs Go-level debugging with HTTPS_PROXY or AWS SDK debug logging.

payload.title: Support locally built images in deployment workflow
payload.description: Compose files reference published GHCR images (ghcr.io/gorbagana-dev/dumpster-backend:latest). For local dev and testing, images are built from source repos (e.g. dumpster-backend) and tagged locally (gorbagana-dev/dumpster-backend-base:local). Need a supported path to use these in Kind deployments. Options: (1) fix image-overrides in laconic-so (blocked by so-5cd), (2) define container_images in woodburn_deployer stack vars and use the existing build-containers + kind-load flow in stack_deploy role, (3) manual kind load docker-image + imagePullPolicy patch. Related: so-5cd (compose deployer ignores image_overrides), stack_deploy role has dead build_containers/container_images code that was never wired up.
